base_dir.description: Base directory where encrypted files are stored (must be specified by user)

mount_point.description: Mount point for decrypted access (must be specified by user)

foreground.description: Run cryfs in foreground mode (required for systemd supervision)

no_update_check.description: Disable internet-based update and vulnerability checks

config_file.description: Custom path for cryfs.config file (instead of base_dir/cryfs.config)

allow_filesystem_upgrade.description: Allow upgrading the filesystem for older CryFS versions

allow_integrity_violations.description: Disable integrity violation checks (e.g., for snapshot use)

allow_replaced_filesystem.description: Allow replacing the filesystem (e.g., after backup restore)

missing_block_is_integrity_violation.description: Treat missing ciphertext blocks as integrity violations (breaks multi-client sync)

unmount_idle.description: Automatically unmount after N minutes of inactivity (0 = disabled)

blocksize.description: Block size in bytes for encrypted storage (default: 32768)

fuse_options.description: List of FUSE options to pass to the filesystem driver (e.g., [allow_root, allow_other])

logfile.description: Path to log file (default: syslog in background, stdout in foreground)
